mapper.select: SELECT c.id as candidate_id, c.profile_complete as is_profile_complete, c.onboarding_stage, c.created_at FROM candidates c WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as approved, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rejected FROM candidate_documents WHERE candidate_id = #{candidateId}
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM job_applications WHERE candidate_id = #{candidateId} GROUP BY status

SELECT ja.id, jd.title as job_title, ctry.name as country, jd.city, jd.salary_amount, jd.salary_currency, ja.status, ja.applied_at FROM job_applications ja INNER JOIN job_demands jd ON ja.job_demand_id = jd.id LEFT JOIN countries ctry ON jd.country_id = ctry.id WHERE ja.candidate_id = #{candidateId} ORDER BY ja.applied_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT jd.id, jd.title, ctry.name as country, jd.city, jd.salary_amount, jd.salary_currency, jd.total_slots, jd.remaining_slots, jd.deadline FROM job_demands jd LEFT JOIN countries ctry ON jd.country_id = ctry.id WHERE jd.is_public = true AND jd.status = #{status} AND jd.is_active = true AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM job_applications ja WHERE ja.job_demand_id = jd.id AND ja.candidate_id = #{candidateId} ) ORDER BY jd.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DATE(ja.applied_at) as date, COUNT(*) as count FROM job_applications ja WHERE ja.candidate_id = #{candidateId} AND ja.applied_at >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE(ja.applied_at) ORDER BY date DESC
SELECT document_type, document_name, status, uploaded_at FROM candidate_documents WHERE candidate_id = #{candidateId} ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_demands WHERE is_public = true AND status = #{status} AND is_active = true
